test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Straddle the fence

options.text: To be persistent in pursuing a goal
To avoid addressing a topic correctly

solution:
The correct answer is: **'****To avoid addressing a topic correctly****'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Straddle the fence"** means **to avoid addressing a topic directly** or to speak in a roundabout way. (मुद्दे की बात को टालना)

 
 
• **Example:** Stop **straddling the fence** and tell me what you really think.
 
 

**​**Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: To be persistent in pursuing a goal** (लक्ष्य को प्राप्त करने में दृढ़ रहना)

 
 
• **Example:** She was persistent in pursuing her dream of becoming a doctor.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: To be impatient and short-tempered** (अधीर और चिड़चिड़ा होना)
 
 
• **Example:** He tends to be impatient and short-tempered when things don't go his way.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: To be direct and formal** (सीधा और औपचारिक होना)
 
 
• **Example:** Her tone was direct and formal during the meeting.
